G4800.def: from «4862» and «2198»; to continue to live in common with, i.e. co-survive (literally or figuratively):--live with.

G4801.def: from «4862» and the base of «2201»; to yoke together, i.e. (figuratively) conjoin (in marriage):--join together.

G4802.def: from «4862» and «2212»; to investigate jointly, i.e. discuss, controvert, cavil:--dispute (with), enquire, question (with), reason (together).

G4803.def: from «4802»; mutual questioning, i.e. discussion:--disputation(-ting), reasoning.

G4805.def: from «4801»; co-yoked, i.e. (figuratively) as noun, a colleague; probably rather as a proper name; Syzygus, a Christian:--yokefellow.

G4806.def: from «4862» and «2227»; to reanimate conjointly with (figuratively):--quicken together with.

G4807.et: of Hebrew origin (08256) in imitation of (4809)
G4807.def: of Hebrew origin («08256») in imitation of «4809»; a sycamore-fig tree:--sycamine tree.

G4809.def: from «4810» and moron (the mulberry); the "sycamore"-fig tree:--sycamore tree. Compare «4807».

G4810.def: apparently a primary word; a fig:--fig.

G4811.et: from a compound of (4810) and a derivative of (5316)
G4811.def: from a compound of «4810» and a derivative of «5316»; to be a fig-informer (reporter of the law forbidding the exportation of figs from Greece), "sycophant", i.e. (genitive and by extension) to defraud (exact unlawfully, extort):--accuse falsely, take by false accusation.

G4812.et: from the base of (4813) and (the reduplicated form of) (71)
G4812.def: from the base of «4813» and (the reduplicated form of) «71»; to lead away as booty, i.e. (figuratively) seduce:--spoil.

G4813.et: from a derivative of sullo (to strip, probably akin to (138), cf (4661))
G4813.def: from a derivative of sullo (to strip; probably akin to «138»; compare «4661»); to despoil:--rob.

G4814.def: from «4862» and «2980»; to talk together, i.e. converse:--commune (confer, talk) with, speak among.

G4815.def: from «4862» and «2983»; to clasp, i.e. seize (arrest, capture); specially, to conceive (literally or figuratively); by implication, to aid:--catch, conceive, help, take.

G4816.et: from (4862) and (3004) in its original sense
G4816.def: from «4862» and «3004» in its original sense; to collect:--gather (together, up).

G4817.def: from «4862» and «3049»; to reckon together (with oneself), i.e. deliberate:--reason with.

G4818.def: from «4862» and «3076»; to afflict jointly, i.e. (passive) sorrow at (on account of) someone:--be grieved.

G4819.def: from «4862» and the base of «939»; to walk (figuratively, transpire) together, i.e. concur (take place):--be(-fall), happen (unto).

G4820.def: from «4862» and «906»; to combine, i.e. (in speaking) to converse, consult, dispute, (mentally) to consider, (by implication) to aid, (personally) to join, attack:--confer, encounter, help, make, meet with, ponder.

G4821.def: from «4862» and «936»; to be co-regent (figuratively):--reign with.

G4822.et: from (4862) and bibazo (to force, causative [by reduplication] of the base of (939))
G4822.def: from «4862» and bibazo (to force; causative (by reduplication) of the base of «939»); to drive together, i.e. unite (in association or affection), (mentally) to infer, show, teach:--compact, assuredly gather, intrust, knit together, prove.

G4823.def: from «4862» and «1011»; to give (or take) advice jointly, i.e. recommend, deliberate or determine:--consult, (give, take) counsel (together).

G4824.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of «4825»; advisement; specially, a deliberative body, i.e. the provincial assessors or lay-court:--consultation, counsel, council.

G4825.def: from «4862» and «1012»; a consultor, i.e. adviser:--counsellor.

G4826.def: from the same as «4613»; Symeon (i.e. Shimon), the name of five Israelites:--Simeon, Simon.

G4827.def: from a compound of «4862» and «3129»; a co-learner (of Christianity):--fellow disciple.

G4828.def: from «4862» and «3140»; to testify jointly, i.e. corroborate by (concurrent) evidence:--testify unto, (also) bear witness (with).

G4829.def: middle voice from «4862» and «3307»; to share jointly, i.e. participate in:--be partaker with.

G4831.et: from a presumed compound of (4862) and (3401)
G4831.def: from a presumed compound of «4862» and «3401»; a co-imitator, i.e. fellow votary:--follower together.

G4832.def: from «4862» and «3444»; jointly formed, i.e. (figuratively) similar:--conformed to, fashioned like unto.

G4833.def: from «4832»; to render like, i.e. (figuratively) to assimilate:--make conformable unto.

G4834.def: from «4835»; to feel "sympathy" with, i.e. (by implication) to commiserate:--have compassion, be touched with a feeling of.

G4835.def: from «4841»; having a fellow-feeling ("sympathetic"), i.e. (by implication) mutually commiserative:--having compassion one of another.

G4836.def: from «4862» and «3854»; to be present together, i.e. to convene; by implication, to appear in aid:--come together, stand with.

G4837.def: from «4862» and «3870»; to console jointly:--comfort together.

G4838.def: from «4862» and «3880»; to take along in company:--take with.

G4839.def: from «4862» and «3887»; to remain in company, i.e. still live:--continue with.

G4840.def: from «4862» and «3918»; to be at hand together, i.e. now present:--be here present with.

G4841.def: from «4862» and «3958» (including its alternate); to experience pain jointly or of the same kind (specially, persecution; to "sympathize"):--suffer with.

G4842.def: from «4862» and «3992»; to despatch in company:--send with.

G4843.et: from (4862) and a compound of (4012) and (2983)
G4843.def: from «4862» and a compound of «4012» and «2983»; to take by enclosing altogether, i.e. earnestly throw the arms about one:--embrace.

G4844.def: from «4862» and «4095»; to partake a beverage in company:--drink with.

G4845.def: from «4862» and «4137»; to implenish completely, i.e. (of space) to swamp (a boat), or (of time) to accomplish (passive, be complete):--(fully) come, fill up.

G4846.def: from «4862» and «4155»; to strangle completely, i.e. (literally) to drown, or (figuratively) to crowd:--choke, throng.

G4847.def: from «4862» and «4177»; a native of the same town, i.e. (figuratively) co-religionist (fellow-Christian):--fellow- citizen.

G4848.def: from «4862» and «4198»; to journey together; by implication, to assemble:--go with, resort.

G4849.et: from a derivative of the alternate of (4844)
G4849.def: neuter of a derivative of the alternate of «4844»; a drinking-party ("symposium"), i.e. (by extension) a room of guests:--company.

G4850.def: from «4862» and «4245»; a co-presbyter:--presbyter, also an elder.

G4851.def: from «4862» and «5342» (including its alternate); to bear together (contribute), i.e. (literally) to collect, or (figuratively) to conduce; especially (neuter participle as a noun) advantage:--be better for, bring together, be expedient (for), be good, (be) profit(-able for).

G4852.def: from «4862» and «5346»; to say jointly, i.e. assent to:--consent unto.

G4853.def: from «4862» and a derivative of «5443»; a co-tribesman, i.e. native of the same country:--countryman.

G4854.def: from «4862» and a derivative of «5453»; grown along with (connate), i.e. (figuratively) closely united to:--planted together.

G4855.def: from «4862» and «5453»; passive, to grow jointly:--spring up with.

G4856.def: from «4859»; to be harmonious, i.e. (figuratively) to accord (be suitable, concur) or stipulate (by compact):--agree (together, with).

G4858.def: from «4859»; unison of sound ("symphony"), i.e. a concert of instruments (harmonious note):--music.

G4859.def: from «4862» and «5456»; sounding together (alike), i.e. (figuratively) accordant (neuter as noun, agreement):-- consent.

G4861.def: from «4862» and «5590»; co-spirited, i.e. similar in sentiment:--like-minded.

G4862.def: a primary preposition denoting union; with or together (but much closer than «3326» or «3844»), i.e. by association, companionship, process, resemblance, possession, instrumentality, addition, etc.:--beside, with. In composition it has similar applications, including completeness.

G4863.def: from «4862» and «71»; to lead together, i.e. collect or convene; specially, to entertain (hospitably):--+ accompany, assemble (selves, together), bestow, come together, gather (selves together, up, together), lead into, resort, take in.

G4864.def: from (the reduplicated form of) «4863»; an assemblage of persons; specially, a Jewish "synagogue" (the meeting or the place); by analogy, a Christian church:--assembly, congregation, synagogue.

G4865.def: from «4862» and «75»; to struggle in company with, i.e. (figuratively) to be a partner (assistant):--strive together with.

G4866.def: from «4862» and «118»; to wrestle in company with, i.e. (figuratively) to seek jointly:--labour with, strive together for.

G4867.def: from «4862» and athroizo (to hoard); to convene:--call (gather) together.

G4868.def: from «4862» and «142»; to make up together, i.e. (figuratively) to compute (an account):--reckon, take.

G4871.def: from «4862» and halizo (to throng); to accumulate, i.e. convene:--assemble together.

G4872.def: from «4862» and «305»; to ascend in company with:--come up with.

G4873.def: from «4862» and «345»; to recline in company with (at a meal):--sit (down, at the table, together) with (at meat).

G4874.et: from (4862) and a compound of (303) and (3396)
G4874.def: from «4862» and a compound of «303» and «3396»; to mix up together, i.e. (figurative) associate with:--(have, keep) company (with).

G4875.def: middle from «4862» and «373»; to recruit oneself in company with:--refresh with.

G4876.def: from «4862» and a derivative of «473»; to meet with; figuratively, to occur:--befall, meet.

G4878.def: from «4862» and «482»; to take hold of opposite together, i.e. co-operate (assist):--help.

G4879.def: from «4862» and «520»; to take off together, i.e. transport with (seduce, passively, yield):--carry (lead) away with, condescend.

G4880.def: from «4862» and «599»; to decease (literally) in company with, or (figuratively), similarly to:--be dead (die) with.

G4881.def: from «4862» and «622»; to destroy (middle voice or passively, be slain) in company with:--perish with.

G4882.def: from «4862» and «649»; to despatch (on an errand) in company with:--send with.

G4883.et: from (4862) and a derivative of a compound of (719) and (3004) (in its original sense of laying)
G4883.def: from «4862» and a derivative of a compound of «719» and «3004» (in its original sense of laying); to render close-jointed together, i.e. organize compactly:--be fitly framed (joined) together.

G4884.def: from «4862» and «726»; to snatch together, i.e. seize:--catch.

G4885.def: from «4862» and «837»; to increase (grow up) together:--grow together.

G4886.def: from «4862» and «1199»; a joint tie, i.e. ligament, (figuratively) uniting principle, control:--band, bond.

G4887.def: from «4862» and «1210»; to bind with, i.e. (passively) be a fellow-prisoner (figuratively):--be bound with.

G4888.def: from «4862» and «1392»; to exalt to dignity in company (i.e. similarly) with:--glorify together.

G4889.def: from «4862» and «1401»; a co-slave, i.e. servitor or ministrant of the same master (human or divine):--fellowservant.

G4890.def: from (the alternate of) «4936»; a running together, i.e. (riotous) concourse:--run together.

G4891.def: from «4862» and «1453»; to rouse (from death) in company with, i.e. (figuratively) to revivify (spirtually) in resemblance to:--raise up together, rise with.

G4892.et: from a presumed derivative of a compound of (4862) and the base of (1476)
G4892.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of a compound of «4862» and the base of «1476»; a joint session, i.e. (specially), the Jewish Sanhedrin; by analogy, a subordinate tribunal:--council.

G4893.def: from a prolonged form of «4894»; co-perception, i.e. moral consciousness:--conscience.

G4894.def: from «4862» and «1492»; to see completely; used (like its primary) only in two past tenses, respectively meaning to understand or become aware, and to be conscious or (clandestinely) informed of:--consider, know, be privy, be ware of.

G4895.def: from «4862» and «1510» (including its various inflections); to be in company with, i.e. present at the time:--be with.

G4896.def: from «4862» and eimi (to go); to assemble:--gather together.

G4897.def: from «4862» and «1525»; to enter in company with:--go in with, go with into.

G4898.def: from «4862» and the base of «1553»; a co-absentee from home, i.e. fellow-traveller:--companion in travel, travel with.

G4899.def: from a compound of «4862» and «1586»; chosen in company with, i.e. co-elect (fellow Christian):--elected together with.
